records.label: spacr.qt.screens.settings_model.SettingsWidgets.set_hidden_value#1
records.source: Some values have a dedicated control outside the form.  Image UMAP's action-strip GPU toggle is one: duplicating it as a form checkbox would create two sources of truth.  Hidden does not mean absent (invariant 6), so the value lives in ``_defaults`` and still reaches collect().
records.context: Some values have a dedicated control outside the form.  Image UMAP's action-strip GPU toggle is one: duplicating it as a form checkbox would create two sources of truth.  Hidden does not mean absent (invariant 6), so the value lives in ``_defaults`` and still reaches collect().
records.translation: Certaines valeurs disposent d’une commande dédiée hors du formulaire. Le commutateur GPU de la barre d’actions d’Image UMAP en est un : le dupliquer comme case à cocher créerait deux sources de vérité. Masqué ne signifie pas manquant (règle immuable 6) ; la valeur reste donc dans ``_defaults`` et atteint toujours collect().
